summary: Iteration 9 — Backend + Frontend regression + Aquanalyse score/tips validation. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (score contract, adjusted_goal with activity bonus, no-health path, minimal defaults, FR/EN language). Frontend: login on mobiletest123@aqua.com/Test1234! OK, 4 tabs (Aujourd'hui / Progrès / Aquacoach / Profil) render without crash. Aquanalyse card (testID insights-card) loads on Progrès tab; testID insights-score renders the /100 badge with score reasons; testID insights-unlock (free-user CTA) renders; testID insights-refresh correctly absent for free user; testID insights-prediction correctly absent for free user. WATER POINTS non-regression PASS: Profil → link-waterpoints navigates to /water-points and shows wp-locked + wp-unlock (Fonctionnalité Premium / Passer Premium) for the free account. DELETE ACCOUNT double-confirm PASS: delete-account-button → delete-continue → delete-confirm (+ delete-cancel), both modals render correctly and account was preserved by cancelling. HOWEVER — BLOCKING ISSUE on Aquanalyse: the LLM (gpt-4o-mini via emergentintegrations) returns malformed JSON ~50% of calls (backend log: `insights error: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 1 column ~500-620`). When the JSON parser throws, the endpoint returns `error:true` with empty summary/tips/prediction (score + reasons still returned deterministically). Consequence in UI: neither `insight-tip-0` nor `insights.summary` render — reviewer requirement 'at least one tip row (testID insight-tip-0) with a bold tip line AND a smaller reason line' therefore FAILS intermittently. Probed 6 sequential /api/insights calls: 3 succeeded with 3 tips each, 3 returned error:true with 0 tips. The exact call the app made during this run also failed (see backend.err.log 18:33:42). No red screen, no Expo crash. Only benign warnings (shadow* deprecated, expo-notifications push-token web polyfill, props.pointerEvents deprecated).

critical.issue: LLM (gpt-4o-mini) frequently returns JSON with an unescaped quote/comma around char 500-620 causing json.loads to throw. Result: ~50% of calls yield {error:true, summary:'', tips:[], prediction:''}. Deterministic score/adjusted_goal/score_reasons still returned. Frontend Aquanalyse card then shows only the score badge — no summary, no tips, no prediction — which contradicts the review's requirement to render insight-tip-0 with a text + reason. Backend log evidence: 'insights error: Expecting , delimiter: line 1 column 545 (char 544)' etc. Root cause: strict `json.loads(raw)` on unconstrained LLM output. Recommended fixes (pick one): (a) call gpt-4o-mini with response_format={type:'json_object'} to force schema, (b) extract the first balanced {...} block via regex before json.loads, (c) retry once on ValueError with a stricter system prompt reminder, (d) return deterministic FR/EN/ES fallback tips built from score_reasons when the LLM fails so the UI always shows at least one tip.

ui_bugs.issue: When /api/insights returns empty tips[] (LLM parse failure — see backend critical bug above), the card renders only the score badge + score_reasons + unlock CTA. Reviewer expectation 'at least one tip row (insight-tip-0)' is not met. Frontend has no fallback UI to show a default tip when insights.tips is empty (line 328-337 only maps visibleTips, so nothing renders when tips.length===0). Consider rendering a deterministic tip derived from score_reasons when insights.tips is empty AND !insightsError.

integration_issues.issue: Card correctly consumes the new payload shape (score, adjusted_goal, score_reasons, summary, tips[{text,reason}], prediction). insightsOnce guards against duplicate calls, but there is NO client-side retry when the response has error:true — the user is stuck on an empty-tips card until they leave and re-enter the tab, and even then the ref guard prevents re-fetching until reload. Consider: (1) if error:true → set insightsError so the 'insights.error' message shows, or (2) don't set insightsOnce on error responses so the next visit retries.

action_items: HIGH — Fix POST /api/insights JSON robustness: either enable OpenAI response_format=json_object on the emergentintegrations LlmChat call, OR extract the first balanced {...} block from the LLM response before json.loads, OR retry once on JSONDecodeError. Verify by hitting /api/insights 10x with the same payload and asserting error:true count == 0.

HIGH — Add a deterministic fallback in app/(tabs)/progress.tsx so that when insights.tips.length === 0 and !insightsError, the card renders at least one localized fallback tip built from insights.score_reasons (e.g. 'Buvez 200 ml maintenant' + reason 'hydratation X/Y ml'). This makes the Aquanalyse UX resilient to any future LLM outage.
MEDIUM — Do not set `insightsOnce.current = true` when the response has `error:true`, so the next visit to Progrès retries the AI call instead of showing a permanently-empty card.
OPTIONAL — Consider surfacing insights.error to insightsError state so the 'insights.error' localized message renders instead of an empty card when the LLM fails.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py lines 198-233: strict json.loads with only a ``` fence strip. Any punctuation slip inside a tip text (which the LLM often produces) will throw and drop the whole payload. Deterministic score/reasons are correctly returned even on failure (defense in depth), but summary/tips/prediction are lost.
app/(tabs)/progress.tsx line 328-337: visibleTips.map renders nothing when tips is empty and never falls back to a default UI element — this is what makes the LLM outage user-visible.
app/(tabs)/progress.tsx line 134: insightsOnce prevents duplicate calls but also prevents retry on failure — one 500-ms LLM hiccup means the user never sees tips until they reload the app.

src/api/waterpoints.ts (not exercised on web headless — premium+geo gated) looks correct: nwr queries, User-Agent header, 3 progressive radii (10/25/50km), 3 mirrors, distinguishes network-error vs genuine-empty via `networkError` var. Cannot be E2E-tested on web preview per review note.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — insight-tip-0 missing: emergentintegrations LlmChat(gpt-4o-mini) returns unstructured text; occasionally the model emits an unescaped quote or trailing comma inside a `text`/`reason` value, breaking `json.loads(raw)`. Backend catches the exception and returns {score, adjusted_goal, score_reasons, summary:'', tips:[], prediction:'', error:true}. Frontend (progress.tsx) doesn't map insights.error onto insightsError, doesn't have a fallback tip, and insightsOnce prevents any auto-retry. So the Aquanalyse card shows only the score badge for the affected sessions. Reproduction: hit `curl -X POST https://fastapi-mobile-port.preview.emergentagent.com/api/insights -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"language":"fr","goal":2350,"consumed_today":1200,"logs_today":4,"hour_of_day":14,"health":{"steps":8200,"sleep_hours":7.5,"resting_heart_rate":62}}'` 6-10 times — roughly half will return `error:true`. Backend log confirms: 'server - ERROR - insights error: Expecting , delimiter: line 1 column 545 (char 544)'. Mitigation: (1) OpenAI response_format=json_object, (2) balanced-brace regex + json.loads, (3) fallback deterministic tips from score_reasons, (4) drop the insightsOnce guard when error:true.
